# Part

class [Part](index.html)(val text: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val inlineData: [Blob](../-blob/index.html)? = null, val fileData: [FileData](../-file-data/index.html)? = null, val functionCall: [FunctionCall](../-function-call/index.html)? = null, val functionResponse: [FunctionResponse](../-function-response/index.html)? = null, val thought: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html)? = null, val thoughtSignature: [ByteArray](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-byte-array/index.html)? = null, val videoMetadata: [VideoMetadata](../-video-metadata/index.html)? = null, val toolCall: [ToolCall](../-tool-call/index.html)? = null, val toolResponse: [ToolResponse](../-tool-response/index.html)? = null, val partMetadata: [Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html)<[String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)?>? = null, val executableCode: [ExecutableCode](../-executable-code/index.html)? = null, val codeExecutionResult: [CodeExecutionResult](../-code-execution-result/index.html)? = null, val mediaResolution: [PartMediaResolution](../-part-media-resolution/index.html)? = null)

A part of a multi-modal prompt or response.

A Part can contain one of the following:

  * text: Plain text.

  * inlineData: Binary data (e.g., image, audio).

  * fileData: Data from a file.

  * functionCall: A call to a function.

  * functionResponse: The response from a function call.

  * toolCall: A tool call the model ran on its own server side.

  * toolResponse: The output of a server-side tool call.

  * executableCode: Code generated by the model to be executed.

  * codeExecutionResult: The result of executing an executableCode part.
